about_the_game:
Synopsis:

Scare: Fatal Picture – The Other Side is a psychological horror game in which you

must take pictures of ghosts to destroy them.

Description:

Scare: Fatal Picture - The Other Side is a psychological horror game where you

play as Saori, a young woman trapped in a ghostly prison to be eaten by the Ghost Queen.

Armed with a camera, you must take pictures of ghosts to destroy them. Every photo

taken can make you stronger.

Earn ghostly points by taking pictures of ghosts and use them to upgrade your camera.

Not all ghosts are enemies. some will work with you in your journey.

After finishing a chapter, test your memory by answering story questions to unlock the

next chapter.

Features:

- Use your camera to destroy ghosts by taking pictures of them

- Collect ghostly points by taking pictures to upgrade your camera

- Experience a deep narrative

- Unlock chapters by answering story questions that test your memory

- Immerse yourself in a horror atmosphere inspired by japanese ghost stories
